name: VDL AI SEO
author: VaultDevLabs

sections.description:
VDL AI SEO helps you write better, more search-focused content without leaving WordPress.

It adds lightweight AI-powered tools directly into the editor to assist with:
– SEO-friendly outlines
– Content structure analysis
– On-page optimization suggestions

The plugin is designed to support your writing workflow — not replace it. You stay in control of your content at all times.

No dashboards. No bloated settings. Just practical SEO assistance where you need it.

Features

  • AI-generated SEO outlines for posts and pages
  • Draft analysis with actionable on-page suggestions
  • Works directly inside the WordPress editor
  • Clean, minimal UI
  • No automatic content publishing
  • No tracking or analytics

How It Works

  1. Open a post or page in the WordPress editor
  2. Generate an SEO-focused outline or analyze existing content
  3. Apply suggestions manually as you write or edit

VDL AI SEO is intended to guide content creation — final decisions always remain with the author.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for VDL AI SEO
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Open any post or page to get started
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically publish content?

No. All content changes are manual.

Does it track users or collect analytics?

No. The plugin does not collect analytics or track visitors.

Is this plugin suitable for beginners?

Yes. It is designed to be simple and unobtrusive.

Will this guarantee SEO rankings?

No. SEO results depend on many factors. This plugin provides guidance, not guarantees.
